source.credit: GTA VI Landmarks Data (CC BY 4.0) — https://map.gtadb.org
source.accuracy: Post-release community survey data in in-game metres, converted onto the Fieldnotes basemap (a pre-release community reconstruction) with an empirically validated transform: leave-one-out median error 30 map units across 431 control landmarks. Placements are approximate and not personally verified in-game. Records marked origin "yanis-2025" are retained from the July 2025 snapshot (YANIS / gta6map, publisher-declared public domain) for notebook continuity.
